verdict.rationale: Token streaming is a fair question for an on-device inference engine, so the axis applies. The pack never documents streaming generated tokens back to an application as they are produced. The only streaming evidence is `needle.stream(chunks)`, which streams live speech transcription. That is a different capability and earns no credit here. The "OpenAI-compatible APIs" mention says nothing about streaming responses.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream generated tokens back to my application as they are produced
